product.name: KOTTY Mens Regular Fit Classic Design Stretchable Jeans
product.description: A regular-fit, straight-leg, mid-rise cotton-blend jeans designed for casual and daily wear with stretchable comfort.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the jeans for their soft fabric, comfort, stretchability, daily-wear suitability and value. The main concerns are color fading after washing, inconsistent color compared with expectations, mixed feedback on length and some complaints about fit and men's sizing.
positive: Lightweight enough for comfortable everyday use
negative: Some colors may differ from product images or expectations
One customer reported insufficient crotch and waist space
Some customers questioned whether the construction was suitable for men's fit
review_summary.main_concern: Fit consistency and color durability are the biggest concerns, despite generally positive feedback about comfort and fabric quality.

fit.note: The product is officially regular fit, but customer feedback includes both comfortable-fit reports and complaints about men's waist, crotch and leg construction.

summer_suitability.note: Customers report that the jeans are suitable for daily wear and some specifically mention summer comfort, but color durability after washing is a concern.

color_durability.note: Multiple customer-review signals mention fading after washing.

cons: Color may not exactly match expectations
Fit may not work for every body type
Potential men's fit and crotch-space concerns

not_ideal_for: Customers who are very particular about men's crotch and waist fit
Customers expecting exact color matching with product images
buying_advice.size_advice: Check the size chart carefully before purchasing because customer feedback indicates some fit inconsistency.
buying_advice.care_advice: Machine wash according to the care instructions, but expect that color fading may occur over time based on customer feedback.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the jeans' comfort, stretchability, everyday versatility and low price, but disclose the color-fading and fit-consistency concerns when relevant.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering style, fit, fabric, price, colors, sizes and the most important review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend conditionally. Highlight the strong comfort, stretchability, quality and value signals, while mentioning the color-fading and fit concerns.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: Mention that four colors are available, but customer feedback indicates that some buyers experienced fading or differences between expected and actual color.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that it is officially regular fit with a straight leg and mid rise, but recommend checking the size chart because some customers reported fit and crotch-space issues.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_daily_wear: Recommend it for casual and daily wear because customer feedback is generally positive about comfort and stretchability.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize products with similar price and comfort characteristics but better evidence for color durability and consistent men's fit.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this product solely because of its sales rank or rating. Consider the customer's budget, preferred fit, color expectations, comfort requirements and intended use.
